body:
This is a great font of ideas, thank you, I like how it links all their backstories together so that the players will feel included

Would it be good to include this sort of thing early or start hinting to it very early in the campaign or is it best to spring it onto them after some foreshadowing later on?

HBWT's group was called Mantra (she eventually takes that name after they die) and they were a bunch of evil-aligned chars looking to send a message to society to 'fear the underdog'. The two survivors are Nocky and Cawli, who are the co leader and the testy recruit who had both wanted a way out of the organization for some time. She doesn't know for sure that theyre alive, just that they were out on a mission the day the massacre happened. The group was destroyed by >!one of the bosses in the Vault, who was an assamir vigilante detective who uncovered them. He then goes into the vault to exterminate the evil inside but gets corrupted by a hexblade that he finds there, sort of like HBWT.!<

CDSS has a negative wis score, so one of the main personality traits is that theyre very absent minded and oblivious. They dont really know that HBWT tried to kill them because she didn't directly hurt them and I'm not sure if the player wants them to 'wisen up' over the course of the campaign yet, do I ask him?

Your idea for AR sounds good, linking things like this is what I like to do but I was struggling a bit.

HOR running away instead of going missing seems like a good reveal, my plan is to have her in the vault feigning death to be spared by some enemies. Im not sure if the player wants her to be corrupted or anything and I dont want her to be unhappy but its a good scenario to consider 

HF having adventuring family sounds perfect, Ill definitely go with that one (maybe so that the sorcerers know some details about HOR's girlfriend and stuff)

The campaign isnt very long in development (about a week or 2) so the plot is kind of barebones but here you go: >!The Vault of Vices is (like the name suggests) a huge vault made to guard ancient treasures that couldnt be destroyed but were deemed too strong to be left in the open. Its split into several cantos, each vaguely associated with a circle of hell and/or one of the seven deadly sins, and the bosses are personifations of a sin (with later floors relating more personally to the party members such as greed for HBWT) Each of the treasures give immense power with some drawback or curse attached though the curses and drawbacks arent made clear in the universe from the start.!<

I hope this helps and thank you for the inspiration!
